title_hint: AI policy aziendale: come scriverla (template operativo per PMI)
dedupNotes: Practical, evergreen template for the internal AI-usage policy a PMI writes for its team (chi puo usare cosa, dati, approvazioni, log). NOT the AI Act pillar (the law) and not the formazione pillar; this is the operative document. Low factual risk, good first auto-publish.

title_hint: Assessment AI interno: la guida operativa prima di chiamare un fornitore
dedupNotes: How to run a lightweight internal AI-readiness assessment (mappare processi, dati, ore perse, baseline) before engaging anyone. Complements the consulenza pillar and the /check-up tool; operative, evergreen, low risk.

title_hint: AI Act per PMI: la checklist operativa di conformita (cosa fare entro agosto 2026)
dedupNotes: Operative step-by-step compliance checklist + timeline. Distinct from /guide/ai-act-aziende (overview of the law) and the blog AI Act posts (high-risk/recruiting): this is 'what to DO'. Every regulatory claim must cite Reg. (UE) 2024/1689 articles; strong fit for the ask-Soraia-for-an-honest-read CTA.

title_hint: Automatizzare la compliance documentale: GDPR, audit trail e report con l'AI
dedupNotes: Operative guide on automating recurring compliance documents (DPA register, audit trail, report ricorrenti) with agents; ties to /finance and the Numeraria case, not a law explainer.

title_hint: NIS2 e PMI italiane: obblighi di cybersecurity e dove l'AI riduce il carico
dedupNotes: What NIS2 obliges for in-scope Italian SMEs and where AI/automation genuinely helps (monitoring, triage, audit). Regulatory, must attribute to the NIS2 directive / ACN; honest about who is actually in scope.

title_hint: Incentivi e credito d'imposta per AI e digitalizzazione PMI 2026: cosa sapere prima di contarci
dedupNotes: Honest landscape of incentives/credito d'imposta touching AI/digitalization, with explicit 'verify with your commercialista, and ask Soraia for an honest read on whether it fits your project' framing. High attribution discipline required (Agenzia delle Entrate / MIMIT sources or cut).

title_hint: Garante Privacy e AI: i punti fermi che ogni PMI deve conoscere
dedupNotes: Operative read of the Italian DPA's stance on AI (basi giuridiche, trasparenza, valutazioni d'impatto) for SMEs. Every cited provvedimento must be named; honest about what is settled vs evolving.

title_hint: AI nel recruitment: perche gli ATS con IA sono ad alto rischio e cosa deve fare l'HR (trasparenza ai candidati)
dedupNotes: Sector-specific compliance angle for Soraia's largest cluster (recruitment), not in backlog or pillars. Annex III classifies personnel selection as high-risk; the Omnibus pushed that obligation deadline to 2 December 2027, but candidate transparency, impact assessment and supplier clauses matter now. Sources: professione-lavoro.it (AI Act and HR tech, 21/06/2026), aipolicy.it draft high-risk guidelines (May 2026), CityNext (Annex III lists selezione del personale, deadline 2 Dec 2027).

title_hint: Chatbot e contenuti IA: come rispettare gli obblighi di trasparenza dell'articolo 50 (dal 2 agosto 2026)
dedupNotes: Operative playbook, not covered by pillar or backlog: how an SMB that runs a support chatbot or generates AI content complies with Article 50 (disclose interaction with AI, label synthetic content). Timely because Art.50 disclosure applies from 2 Aug 2026 while machine-readable watermarking was pushed to 2 Dec 2026 by the Omnibus. Sources: EU Commission digital-strategy page (transparency rules Aug 2026), Travers Smith state-of-play, CityNext (watermarking 2 Dec 2026).

title_hint: Legge 132/2025: l'obbligo di informare lavoratori e clienti sull'uso dell'IA (cosa fare in pratica)
dedupNotes: Net-new because it covers the ITALIAN national law (L.132/2025), distinct from the EU AI Act pillar, and the specific in-force information duty (from 10 October 2025) toward workers and clients - not covered by the ai-policy template (which teaches how to write a policy). Links the reader to the policy template as the operative next step. Sources: lavorosi.it (WST Law and Tax, 09/10/2025) and gdpr.it on L.132/2025 employer obligations.

title_hint: Digital Omnibus e AI Act: cosa e stato rinviato al 2027-2028 e cosa NO (guida per PMI)
dedupNotes: Net-new vs the ai-act-aziende pillar (static overview) and the parked ai-act-checklist (a to-do list for Aug 2026): this is a dated news-reaction on what the Digital Omnibus actually moved. Sources: CityNext 05/07/2026 timeline, Council of the EU final approval 29/06/2026 and political agreement 07/05/2026, EU Commission digital-strategy AI Act page. Distinguishes postponed high-risk (2 Dec 2027 / 2 Aug 2028) from confirmed items (Art.5 bans, Art.50 transparency, GPAI, AI literacy) and the 2 Dec 2026 watermarking date.

title_hint: Comprare IA senza scoprirti: la checklist di clausole contrattuali per i fornitori (GDPR + AI Act)
dedupNotes: Procurement/due-diligence angle absent from backlog and pillars: the AI Act shifts responsibility along the supply chain, so contracts with AI vendors need compliance warranties, technical documentation, and recourse clauses. Distinct from ai-policy (internal) and consulenza pillar (buyer guide). Sources: aipolicy.it contract clauses checklist (04/04/2026), Orrick 6-steps (Nov 2025), Baker McKenzie EU AI regulation note on reviewing AI-related contracts.

title_hint: DPIA e FRIA per i sistemi di IA: quando servono davvero e come impostarle senza sprechi
dedupNotes: Operative deliverable-focused topic distinct from the parked garante-privacy item (which is about the Garante's fixed points): explains when a GDPR DPIA and an AI Act fundamental-rights impact assessment (FRIA) are required, and how to run them together. Reinforced by the EDPB-EDPS Joint Opinion 1/2026 warning that simplification must not lower protections. Sources: EDPB-EDPS Joint Opinion 1/2026, artificialintelligenceact.eu SME resources, EU Commission digital-strategy page.
